notes: Resolved as unscoreable on Day's own figures: the sentence has no numbers, so its comparison cannot be checked until the mesa counts, units and window are released (fidelity unverifiable, rule F). The audit's reading (191 and 840 per lineage over 252,000 generations; 252,000 is verified: false in parameters) is held from R4 FM, not re-run. Since 840 > 191 the MITTENS ceiling adds nothing once the Haldane one is passed. Comparing a mesa's substitution count with Haldane's cost presupposes the substitutions are selected (M-801); a neutral high-mutation block meets the same count on every lineage, which is what R4 FM finds.
